name: Contadina Roma Tomato Paste (Concentrated Acid WARNING)
whyItWorks: Highly concentrated tomato solids and citric acid. The intense acid density can provoke sharp upper GI reflux, burning sensations, and direct irritation of inflamed mucosal tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid heavy use in sauces during active flares. Dilute thoroughly with bone broth or choose pumpkin puree.
